purpose: Static screening of the one- and two-proton C12 primary inventory cases.
notes: Each target card supplies its fixed uncompressed density from 20 K liquid-H2 and solid-carbon component densities using a no-void additive-specific-volume mixture rule. Rc is scanned directly; rows with Rc > R0 are excluded. Ti is derived from the cold isentrope plus the 30% first-pass thermal-energy addition, not scanned independently.
